ja: 『デジモンアドベンチャー02』より主人公のパートナーデジモンの進化形「マグナモン」が立体化！
■各関節が広範囲に可動。劇中さながらのアクションポーズを再現できる。
■肩アーマーは２軸で可動。接続部のジョイントパーツにより上下左右に大きく動かせる。また、腰パーツと合わせて内部の形状に至るまで細かい造型も再現。
■組み立てるだけで満足できるパーツ分割。マグナモンの四肢の有機的な造型も再現。
en: From "Digimon Adventure 02 ", the evolved form of the main character's partner Digimon " Magnamon" is now three-dimensional!
• Each joint has a wide range of motion. You can recreate action poses just like in the movie.

• Shoulder armor can move on 2 axes. The joint parts at the connection part allow for large movements up, down, left and right. In addition, the detailed molding, including the internal shape, is also reproduced along with the waist parts.
• Part division that can be satisfied just by assembling. The organic shape of Magnamon's limbs is also reproduced.
